moments.title: Strictly's First Live Show Tonight!
moments.blurb: The 2026 series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off its first live show tonight with new hosts Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe, and Josh Widdicombe, and all 15 couples dancing for the first time.

angles.name: Strictly is LIVE
angles.copy: Glitter, glamour, and live nerves! Strictly Come Dancing 2026 goes LIVE tonight for the very first time this series. Who are you backing?

angles.name: New Hosts Debut
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe, and Josh Widdicombe take the helm for their first live Strictly show tonight. Big shoes to fill – what do you think of the new presenting trio?

angles.name: Robbie Williams song
angles.copy: Will Best and Dianne Buswell are dancing the Samba to Robbie Williams' 'Rock DJ' on Strictly tonight! Get ready for some noughties nostalgia on the dancefloor.

moments.title: Bake Off: Nigella Lawson's Debut
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off 2026 has returned, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as the new judge, replacing Prue Leith, and the first episode already saw some baking mishaps.

angles.name: Nigella in the tent
angles.copy: New series, new judge! Nigella Lawson has officially joined The Great British Bake Off tent alongside Paul Hollywood. Are you loving the new flavour?

angles.name: Cake disasters
angles.copy: It wouldn't be Bake Off without a little drama! The new series has already seen cakes on the floor. Who else is watching through their fingers?

moments.title: All-Female Domination on UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: For only the second time in chart history, the UK Official Singles Chart Top 6 is entirely made up of female artists, with Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' holding the number one spot for a third week.

angles.name: Chart Queens
angles.copy: History made! The UK Official Singles Chart Top 6 is ALL female this week. Sienna Spiro, Ella Langley, Stella Lefty, Adéla, Dua Lipa, and Olivia Rodrigo are owning the airwaves!

angles.name: Sienna Spiro No.1
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro is holding strong at UK Number 1 for a third week with 'Great Expectation'! What a run for the 20-year-old sensation.

moments.title: Happy 81st to Bryan Ferry
moments.blurb: Bryan Ferry, the iconic lead singer of Roxy Music, celebrates his 81st birthday today, September 26.

angles.name: Bryan Ferry 81 today
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the legendary Bryan Ferry! From Roxy Music's art-rock to his solo sophistication, what's your favourite Ferry track?

moments.title: Christina Milian Turns 45
moments.blurb: American R&B singer and actress Christina Milian, known for hits like 'Dip It Low', celebrates her 45th birthday today, September 26.

angles.name: Christina Milian 45
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to the incredible Christina Milian! We're still 'Dip It Low'-ing to her tunes.

moments.title: Boyz II Men's Shawn Stockman Turns 54
moments.blurb: Shawn Stockman, a founding member of the iconic R&B group Boyz II Men, celebrates his 54th birthday today, September 26.

angles.name: Shawn Stockman 54
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to Shawn Stockman of Boyz II Men! Still got those 'End of the Road' vibes on repeat.

moments.title: Loch Lomond BAKEFEST26
moments.blurb: Scotland's Loch Lomond BAKEFEST26 is taking place today and tomorrow (September 26-27) in Balloch, offering a celebration of baking, artisan sweet treats, and live demonstrations.

angles.name: Bakefest in Balloch
angles.copy: Got a sweet tooth? Loch Lomond BAKEFEST26 is happening in Balloch today and tomorrow! Get ready for cakes, pastries, and live baking demos by the bonnie, bonnie banks.

moments.title: Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Tulleys Farm in West Sussex is hosting its Pumpkin Festival until October 31, featuring over a million pumpkins, seasonal food, and entertainment, marking the start of Halloween season.

angles.name: Pumpkin Patch Vibes
angles.copy: Autumn is officially here! Tulleys Farm's Pumpkin Festival in West Sussex is in full swing with over a million pumpkins. Time to get spooky!

moments.title: Sense and Sensibility Film Release
moments.blurb: A new film adaptation of 'Sense and Sensibility', filmed in Dartmoor and Devon, is released today, September 26, bringing local scenery to the big screen.

angles.name: Devon on the Big Screen
angles.copy: Our beautiful Dartmoor and Devon scenery takes centre stage! The new 'Sense and Sensibility' film, shot locally, is out today. Will you be watching?

moments.title: Gwen Stefani's 57th Birthday
moments.blurb: Gwen Stefani, the lead singer of No Doubt and a successful solo artist, will celebrate her 57th birthday on October 3.

angles.name: Gwen Stefani turns 57
angles.copy: Get ready to say 'Holla Back Girl!' Gwen Stefani celebrates her 57th birthday on October 3rd. What's your favourite No Doubt or solo hit?

moments.title: AC/DC's Brian Johnson Turns 79
moments.blurb: Brian Johnson, the iconic frontman of AC/DC, will celebrate his 79th birthday on October 5.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Brian Johnson
angles.copy: Thunderstruck! AC/DC's legendary vocalist Brian Johnson turns 79 on October 5th. What's your go-to AC/DC anthem?

moments.title: Sir Bob Geldof's 75th Birthday
moments.blurb: Sir Bob Geldof, lead singer of The Boomtown Rats and renowned activist, will celebrate his 75th birthday on October 5.

angles.name: Bob Geldof turns 75
angles.copy: It's Boomtown Rats legend Sir Bob Geldof's 75th birthday on October 5th! A true rock icon and humanitarian. What's your favourite from him?

moments.title: Heavy Rain Forecast for North Wales
moments.blurb: North Wales is forecast to experience potentially heavy and persistent rainfall early next week, as a weather front moves across the UK.

angles.name: Wet week for North Wales
angles.copy: Heads up, North Wales! Potentially heavy and persistent rain is on the way early next week. Don't forget your brollies!

moments.title: King George's Hall Reopens in Blackburn
moments.blurb: The historic King George's Hall in Blackburn, Lancashire, reopens today, September 26, after extensive renovations, ready to host a new programme of events.

angles.name: Blackburn's historic venue
angles.copy: Great news for music and culture fans! Blackburn's iconic King George's Hall reopens today after major renovations. Who's excited to see a show there?
